title: decision/1
description: The only thing that lets a rule be loosened or retired, or a judged rule block. For the gate it must already be on the base ruleset.

from_version.description: the rule version a loosen or retire starts from (required for a rule loosening)

to_version.description: the rule version a loosen allows (required for a rule loosening)

profile_digest.description: for rule = profile: the digest of the profile a loosen allows
